problems.prompt: An object 4.0 cm in size, is placed at 25.0 cm in front of a concave mirror of focal length 15.0 cm. At what distance from the mirror should a screen be placed in order to obtain a sharp image? Find the nature and the size of the image.
problems.attempt_hint: Mirror formula (1/v + 1/u = 1/f) lagao. Concave ki f aur object ka u hamesha negative hota hai.

solution_steps.narration: Reciprocal lo image distance nikalne ke liye.
Magnification nikalne ka formula use karo.

problems.answer: v = -37.5 cm, Image is real, inverted, and 6.0 cm tall.

problems.prompt: A convex mirror used for rear-view on an automobile has a radius of curvature of 3.00 m. If a bus is located at 5.00 m from this mirror, find the position, nature and magnification of the image.
problems.attempt_hint: Pehle R se f nikal lo (f = R/2). Convex ka focus positive hota hai.

solution_steps.narration: Fractions ko solve karo (decimals ko fraction banakar LCM lo ya direct add karo).
Reciprocal lo v nikalne ke liye.

problems.answer: v = +1.15 m, Image is virtual, erect, and magnification is 0.23.

problems.prompt: Light enters from air to glass having refractive index 1.50. What is the speed of light in the glass? The speed of light in vacuum is 3 × 10^8 m/s.
problems.attempt_hint: Speed in medium nikalne ke liye formula n = c / v use karo.

solution_steps.narration: Absolute refractive index ka formula likho.
Speed in medium (v) ke liye formula rearrange karo.

problems.prompt: A concave lens has focal length of 15 cm. At what distance should the object from the lens be placed so that it forms an image at 10 cm from the lens? Also, find the magnification.
given: v = -10 cm (image formed by concave lens is always virtual and on the same side)
problems.attempt_hint: Lens formula (1/v - 1/u = 1/f) lagao, mirror nahi! Aur concave lens ka f aur v dono negative hote hain.

solution_steps.narration: Values substitute karo signs ke sath.
1/u terms ko ek taraf aur baki sab dusri taraf karo.

problems.answer: Object distance u = -30 cm, Magnification m = +0.33

problems.prompt: Find the focal length of a lens of power -2.0 D. What type of lens is this?
problems.attempt_hint: Power ka formula P = 1/f (in meters) lagao. Minus sign lens ka type bata dega.

solution_steps.narration: Solve karke meters mein answer nikalo.
Negative focal length matlab lens divering hai.

problems.answer: Focal length = -0.5 m (or -50 cm), Lens = Concave lens
